87tommy_inline void tommy_arrayblkof_grow(tommy_arrayblkof* array, tommy_size_t size)
88{
89 if (size > array->count) {
90 array->count = size;

92 if (size > array->block_count * TOMMY_ARRAYBLKOF_SIZE)

132tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayblkof_ref(tommy_arrayblkof* array, tommy_size_t pos)
133{
134 assert(pos < array->count);
135
136 return array->block[pos / TOMMY_ARRAYBLKOF_SIZE] + (pos % TOMMY_ARRAYBLKOF_SIZE) * array->element_size;
137}

156tommy_inline void* tommy_arrayblkof_insert_tail(tommy_arrayblkof* array)
157{
158 tommy_size_t pos = array->count;
159
160 ++array->count;
161 if (array->count > array->block_count * TOMMY_ARRAYBLKOF_SIZE)
162 tommy_arrayblkof_reserve(array, array->count);
163
164 return tommy_arrayblkof_ref(array, pos);
165}

172tommy_inline void tommy_arrayblkof_remove_tail(tommy_arrayblkof* array)
173{
174 assert(array->count != 0);
175
176 tommy_size_t pos = array->count - 1;
177 void* ptr = tommy_arrayblkof_ref(array, pos);
178
179 /* keep unused slots zero so growing within capacity needs no initialization */
180 memset(ptr, 0, array->element_size);
181 array->count = pos;
182}
